newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Silitek unit Lite-On increases FRN issue.
newsitem.headline: Silitek unit Lite-On increases FRN issue.

text.p: Silitek Corp unit Lite-On Peripherals (Hong Kong) Ltd's floating rate note issue has been increased to US$30 million in syndication from US$25 million, arranger Standard Chartered Investment Bank said.

The notes have a final maturity of five years but can be put or called on the third anniversary. They pay a coupon of 70 basis points and, with fees, and all-in return of 80 basis points to the top tier.
Arrangers and lead managers, with US$4 million each, are Standard Chartered Investment Banking and Taiwan Cooperative Bank Offshore Banking branch.
Co-lead managers, with US$4 million each, are Banque Indosuez Taipei branch, Commerz (East Asia) and Taishin International Bank.
Senior managers, with US$3 million each, are Kredietbank and Pan Asia Bank.
Managers, with US$2 million each, are Banca Nazionale del Lavoro Hong Kong branch and Fubon Commercial Bank Offshore Banking branch.
